warnings: 7 load cases turn the column toward the right. This model is laid out for cases turning it toward the left, so they are left out here: check them in a second design built with "Lay out for: right".
Bearings at 1.5 ft, 41.5 ft are more than twice the cap's depth from a column face. That part of the cap is not a disturbed region; sectional design (AASHTO 5.7) may suit it better (AASHTO 5.8.2.1).
As a pin-jointed truss the model has 3 mechanism(s). It carries these loads in equilibrium, which a strut-and-tie model needs, but check that the surrounding concrete restrains the free motion.
